security.title: Two-Factor Authentication
security.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a code from an authenticator app when you log in.
security.setupStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, etc.)
security.setupStep2: Then enter the 6-digit code it generates to confirm
security.backupCodesDescription: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.
security.disableDescription: Enter your password to confirm. Your account will no longer require a verification code to log in.
security.regenerateDescription: Enter your password to generate a new set of backup codes. Your previous codes will stop working.
